bio: Afternoon Tea at The Savoy is served in The Thames Foyer putting you very much at the heart of one of London's iconic hotels.  A stunning glass dome floods this sociable spot with natural light and a pianist serenades guests from a garden gazebo, as they enjoy the world-famous Afternoon Tea.  An extensive range of over 30 teas are accompanied by twists on classic sandwiches, homemade scones with clotted cream, jam, and lemon curd, and the talented pastry team’s selection of pastries, each one a tempting work of art. To this day, The Savoy honours the traditional service style of Afternoon Tea, a custom that dates back to 1840.  In addition to their renowned traditional Afternoon Tea and High Tea, The Savoy also offer Vegan Afternoon Tea, Vegetarian Afternoon Tea and Children's Afternoon Tea menus.  Guests have been going to the Thames Foyer to enjoy The Savoy’s renowned Afternoon Tea for over a century. Enjoy a stunning dining experience that has stood the test of time.
